name: Remix Song
description: Plays a song again in another style: the same song as a cover, a remix or a different genre, on a music model.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: The style to play it in: genre, mood, instruments, voice.

inputs.name: lyrics
inputs.label: Lyrics
inputs.description: Sung as written, with [verse] and [chorus] lines to part it. Empty: no words are given to the model, so the singing may change or go.

inputs.name: instrumental
inputs.label: Instrumental
inputs.description: No singing. The lyrics are ignored.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.label: Strength
inputs.description: How much of the original is kept: 1 follows it throughout, lower leaves the model more freedom, 0 ignores it.

inputs.name: stay_close
inputs.label: Stay close
inputs.description: Keep the tune, timing and sound of the original and change the style around it. Off: a looser reinterpretation.
